text:
maria: RC 378 artifacts uploaded. Need final signoff for promo window 03:00-04:00 UTC. Canary 5% -> full. Pin: rc-378+hf. KV warm required. QA: green. @kevin @alex @sheriff-oncall please ack.

deploy-bot: Deploy build rc-378+hf queued. ETA window 03:00 UTC. To promote run: `deployctl promote --artifact rc-378+hf --env prod --canary 5%` :robot_face:

kevin: Ack from infra. I'll start kv-warm script 02:45 UTC. :thumbsup:

alex: Looked at smoke logs, nothing suspicious. Approve from QA. :white_check_mark:

irina: Telemetry gate still showing 2 failing queries in the latency alert group — prefer to hold until one more sweep. Can we delay 10m if needed?

maria: Good catch @irina. We can hold for 10m. If telemetry clears by 02:55 we'll proceed. If not, rollback vote now?

sheriff-oncall: I'm on pager. If we see error rate >0.5% during canary, immediate rollback. I vote go if telemetry ok. :raised_hand:

kevin: KV warm started. Patch in canary namespace to pre-warm shards.

deploy-bot: Promotion checklist:
- artifacts pinned ✅
- kv warm in progress ✅
- canary traffic route ready ✅
- rollback command tested ✅

Rollback command (tested):
``
deployctl rollback --artifact rc-377-stable --env prod --traffic 100%
```

irina: Telemetry cleared at 02:53, all alerts back to green. :partyparrot:

maria: OK we're green. @sheriff-oncall final?

sheriff-oncall: Go for promo. I'm watching. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Promotion started at 02:59:05 UTC. Canary 5% routing applied.

maria: Monitoring smoke dashboards. No regressions after first 10m.

sheriff-oncall: No anomalies. Proceed to 50% at 03:10. If anything, abort to rc-377.

deploy-bot: Traffic now at 50%.

alex: Saw a spike in token errors at 03:12 but resolved by 03:13 after worker restart, no user impact. Continue.

maria: Promoting to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete at 03:20:11 UTC. rc-378+hf is live in prod. Release notes draft: "RC-378: latency improvements, kv pre-warm, hotfix for token serialization". add to release notes repo.

maria: Thanks everyone. Filing post-deploy checklist and linking release notes. :tada:
